TITLE: Q2 Strategic Review and Resource Allocation Meeting Notes

June 6, 2025  
Attendees: Project Laboel lead, Project Drugilett lead, Zevus Lokramel, finance representative, operations lead, HR representative, facilities manager, and senior engineering representative.

The Q2 Strategic Review and Resource Allocation meeting was held to assess the status of active projects, discuss cross-functional challenges, and align on resource planning across departments. The meeting focused on Project Laboel and Project Drugilett, both of which are being developed on the Sestan Loom platform. A key point of discussion was the allocation of shared resources and the coordination of timelines to avoid bottlenecks.

Zevus Lokramel presented an overview of the incident response tooling initiatives, including recent improvements in system monitoring and escalation protocols. These updates were highlighted as critical for maintaining the stability of the Sestan Loom during both project lifecycles. The team expressed appreciation for the work being done to enhance resilience in the event of system outages or performance issues.

Project Laboel, which is staffed by 32 people, remains on track for its current deliverables. The team acknowledged the complexity of aligning with the Sestan Loom, particularly in relation to integration with external vendors. The finance representative confirmed that the project has an approved budget of $3.1M, and that expenses are currently within projected limits. The finance lead encouraged continued cost discipline, particularly in relation to third-party dependencies.

Project Drugilett, also built on the Sestan Loom, was discussed in the context of its shared infrastructure with Project Laboel. The team noted the importance of close coordination between the two projects to ensure compatibility and minimize conflicts. A shared timeline for system upgrades and maintenance was proposed, with the goal of streamlining development and testing phases.

The status of the $3.0M contract with Nilverine Fabrication was reviewed. The finance representative confirmed that the contract is active and progressing as expected. The operations lead emphasized the need for continued monitoring to ensure that all deliverables under the contract align with Zastama Industries’ internal timelines and requirements. A plan was proposed to conduct a mid-quarter review of the contract’s progress and any potential adjustments to scope or delivery.

HR and facilities teams provided updates on workforce planning and office readiness. The facilities manager confirmed that additional workspaces are being prepared to accommodate potential expansion of the Project Laboel team. The HR representative shared that recruitment is ongoing, with a focus on maintaining expertise in the Sestan Loom platform and incident response protocols.

Discussions on cross-departmental collaboration emphasized the importance of communication channels and regular check-ins between engineering teams and external vendors. The operations lead recommended a monthly meeting to address shared challenges and ensure alignment between internal teams and external partners.

Decisions:
- A shared timeline for Project Laboel and Project Drugilett will be created to avoid conflicts in system upgrades and testing phases.
- A mid-quarter review of the Nilverine Fabrication contract will be scheduled to assess progress and alignment with internal timelines.
- Monthly cross-departmental meetings will be established to address shared challenges and ensure coordination between engineering teams and external vendors.
- The facilities team will begin preparing additional workspaces for potential expansion of the Project Laboel team.
- HR will continue to focus recruitment efforts on individuals with experience in the Sestan Loom platform and incident response protocols.

Action Items:
- Project Laboel lead to draft a shared timeline with the Project Drugilett lead by June 20, 2025.
- Finance representative to coordinate the mid-quarter review of the Nilverine Fabrication contract, with results shared by July 3, 2025.
- Operations lead to schedule and coordinate the first monthly cross-departmental meeting, targeting July 10, 2025.
- Facilities manager to confirm workspace readiness for the Project Laboel team by June 25, 2025.
- HR representative to provide an update on recruitment efforts by June 18, 2025.
